en.headline: Police investigate theft of rings and cash worth about HK$250,000 from Ho Man Tin flat
en.dek: A 46-year-old woman reported that two rings and about HK$2,000 in cash were missing from her King's Park Hill residence after she discovered the loss on Sunday morning.
body: Police are investigating a theft at a flat in King's Park Hill, Ho Man Tin, after a resident reported valuables missing.

Officers received a report at about 11am on Sunday from a 46-year-old woman who said two rings, valued at about HK$200,000 and HK$45,000 respectively, together with roughly HK$2,000 in cash, had been taken from her home.
The case has been classified as theft and handed to the Yau Tsim District crime squad. No arrests have been made so far and the investigation is continuing.
Police have appealed for anyone with information to come forward.

zh.headline: 何文田京士柏山單位失竊 兩戒指及現金共約25萬元
zh.dek: 警方表示，46歲女住戶周日早上報稱寓所內兩枚戒指及約2000元現金不見，案件列作盜竊。
body: 警方正調查何文田京士柏山一宗盜竊案，事主報稱寓所內財物失竊。
周日上午約11時，一名46歲女子報案，指其京士柏山道寓所內兩枚分別價值約20萬及4.5萬元的戒指，以及約2000元現金不翼而飛。
警方將案件列作盜竊，交由油尖警區刑事調查隊跟進，目前暫未有人被捕，調查仍在進行。
警方呼籲市民如有任何資料，可向警方提供。
